subject: HAM-HKG by 30 Nov, order PO-2026-5512
body:
Hello,

please quote air freight from Hamburg (HAM) to Hong Kong (HKG): 4 pallets of measuring instruments, 620 kg gross, 2.4 cbm. We deliver to the airport ourselves; the goods are ready on Friday 27 November.

The goods must arrive in Hong Kong no later than Monday 30 November. Within that, the cheapest option please, all-in in EUR. Please quote our purchase order PO-2026-5512 and attach the offer as a PDF.

Best regards
Jana Kraus
Logistics
Kraus Feinmechanik GmbH, Bremen
